title: Fed Prints, Morgan Stanley Declares War
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

Wall Street just turned on itself. Morgan Stanley's moving for physical Bitcoin supply—this isn't product competition, it's a land grab for the actual float. Control the coins, control the price.

Three signals converged this week: $787 million into Bitcoin ETFs, the Fed just gave Kraken a reserve bank account—same plumbing as JPMorgan—and MicroStrategy deployed a billion dollars in a single session. No board meetings. No phased allocation. That's sovereignty-level execution.
